TaskDescription: Task assessing spatial perspective taking and orientation judgments.

date_time.Description: UTC date and time at which the record was created.

is_relevant.Description: Whether the row contains a task-relevant observation rather than instructions, a cue, or another non-scored event.

screen_size.Description: Screen dimensions reported by the web application in width-by-height pixels.

time_elapsed_ms.Description: Elapsed time from task start when the record was created.

ua.Description: Browser user-agent string recorded by the web application.

version.Description: Version of the study web application used to administer the task.

trial_index.Description: Sequential trial or event index assigned by the task application.

stimulus.Description: Stimulus, instructions, cue, or resource presented; may contain text, HTML, or a resource URL.

center.Description: Object at the center of the spatial scene.

facing.Description: Object toward which the imagined observer is facing.

target.Description: Object whose direction the participant indicates.

target_radians.Description: Correct angular direction of the target.

response_radians.Description: Angular direction indicated by the participant.

response_time_ms.Description: Response latency recorded by the task application.

signed_radian_distance.Description: Signed angular difference between target and response.

time_limit_ms.Description: Remaining or assigned response time limit.
